notes.title: Update 1.1 is now live!
Update 1.1 is now open for testing!
notes.notes: Hi, Earlgrey here. It's been a month since release and now im proudly present first major update to the game! It includes battles on ships, more activity while traveling on the sea overall, new dungeons, spells, monsters and much more. Since new changes need to be tested, update will be put on "Unstable" branch for a few days. Full list of changes will be released along with update itself. Stay tuned!
